name: Pick and Place
description: Robot picks an object from a source location and places it at a target location.

phases.name: Approach
phases.description: Robot moves end-effector above the target object.
phases.transition_condition: ee within horizontal threshold of object, above grasp height

phases.name: Pre-Grasp
phases.description: Robot descends to grasp pose with gripper open.
phases.transition_condition: ee at grasp height, gripper fully open

phases.name: Grasp
phases.transition_condition: gripper aperture below threshold, contact force detected

phases.name: Lift
phases.description: Robot raises the object to a safe transport height.
phases.transition_condition: ee height above lift threshold, object height tracking ee

phases.name: Transport
phases.description: Robot moves the object horizontally to above the target location.
phases.transition_condition: ee within horizontal threshold of target location

phases.name: Lower
phases.description: Robot descends to place the object at the target location.
phases.transition_condition: object contact with surface detected or ee at place height

phases.name: Release
phases.description: Gripper opens and releases the object.

phases.name: Retreat
phases.description: Robot moves end-effector away from the placed object.
phases.transition_condition: ee distance from object above threshold

name: Screwing
description: Robot picks up a screw driver or bit, aligns it with a screw hole, and drives the screw to a target torque.

phases.name: Approach Screw
phases.description: Robot moves end-effector above the screw or driver tool.
phases.transition_condition: ee within horizontal threshold of tool, above grasp height

phases.name: Tool Grasp
phases.description: Gripper closes around the screwdriver or bit.
phases.transition_condition: gripper aperture below threshold, contact force detected

phases.name: Approach Hole
phases.description: Robot moves end-effector to above the target screw hole.
phases.transition_condition: ee within horizontal threshold of hole position

phases.name: Alignment
phases.description: Robot descends and aligns tool tip axially with the screw hole.
phases.transition_condition: tool tip within positional and angular tolerance of hole axis

phases.name: Insertion
phases.description: Robot applies downward force to seat the tool tip into the screw head.
phases.transition_condition: contact force above threshold, tool tip engaged with screw head

phases.name: Driving
phases.description: Robot rotates the tool while applying axial force to drive the screw.
phases.transition_condition: screw depth nearing target or torque rising

phases.name: Seating
phases.description: Robot reduces rotation speed and monitors torque as screw seats.
phases.transition_condition: measured torque reaches target torque threshold

phases.name: Retract
phases.description: Robot lifts tool away from the driven screw.
phases.transition_condition: ee height above retract threshold, no contact force
